record.original_question: If G is a triangle-free planar graph, is its list packing number always at most 4? In other words, must chi*_l(G) <= 4 hold for every triangle-free planar graph G?

evidence.quote: The list packing number chi*_l(G) of G is the least k such that G admits an L-packing of size k for any k-list-assignment L of G.
Problem 2.8 For a triangle-free planar graph G, is it true that chi*_l(G) <= 4?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G = (V, E) be a finite simple graph. A list assignment for G is a function L that assigns to each vertex v ∈ V a finite set L(v) of allowed colors; L is called a k-list-assignment if |L(v)| = k for every v ∈ V. A proper L-coloring of G is a function f with f(v) ∈ L(v) for every v and f(u) ≠ f(v) whenever uv ∈ E.

An L-packing of size k is a collection (f_1, f_2, …, f_k) of proper L-colorings of G such that for every vertex v ∈ V the values f_1(v), f_2(v), …, f_k(v) are pairwise distinct (i.e., {f_1(v),…,f_k(v)} = L(v) when |L(v)| = k).

The list packing number χ_ℓ^*(G) is defined as the least integer k such that, for every k-list-assignment L of G, an L-packing of size k exists.

A graph G is planar if it admits an embedding in the plane with no edge crossings, and triangle-free if it contains no 3-cycle.

Question: Is it true that χ_ℓ^*(G) ≤ 4 for every triangle-free planar graph G?
artifact.status_search_result: The list packing number is a recently introduced invariant (Cambie, van Batenburg, Davies, Kang, "Packing list-colourings", 2024). Searches return active research on list packing of planar and triangle-free planar graphs but no resolution of the specific question whether χ_ℓ^*(G) ≤ 4 holds for every triangle-free planar graph. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Packing list-colorings - Cambie et al.
status_evidence.snippet: The list packing number is the least k such that there are always k disjoint proper list-colourings whenever we have lists all of size k.
status_evidence.claim: Defines the list packing number; the bound for triangle-free planar graphs is not asserted as resolved.

status_evidence.title: Fractional List Packing for Layered Graphs - Cambie
status_evidence.snippet: Fractional list packing number arising from disjoint list-colourings; results for layered graphs including planar graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work continues to investigate list packing on planar graphs without settling χ_ℓ^*(G) ≤ 4 for triangle-free planar G.

status_evidence.title: List colouring triangle free planar graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Triangle-free planar graphs are 4-choosable (Alon–Tarsi/Lam et al.), but list packing is a stronger requirement.
status_evidence.claim: 4-choosability is known; the analogous list-packing bound 4 is the open Problem 2.8.
